desktop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished desktop battle-screen reference for the Russian pixel-art lighthouse defense game «Маяк». Output a single landscape 16:9 game screen, ideally 1792×1008, filling the image with no monitor frame, no external captions, no presentation board.
Input images: image 1 (desktop preparation screenshot) is the PRIMARY world, pixel style, slate material, lettering and object identity reference; image 2 (ghost reference board) is ONLY a reference for the pale hooded ghost silhouette and warm light hitting a ghost. Do not copy its board, serif type or text.
Visual continuity is essential: retain the recognizable irregular layered rocky coastline running vertically, mossy land on LEFT, dark blue sea with foam on RIGHT, the same narrow dark stone lighthouse with warm amber lantern and red-brown cap near the middle of the coast, the small wooden pier just below it, two bronze cannons inland above-left and below-left of lighthouse, and a short stone barrier farther left. Same tilted top-down view with no sky/horizon; no new island, castle or roads. Same deliberate crisp pixel art, stepped edges, limited color clusters and sharp pixel Cyrillic lettering as preparation, not smooth painted or vector UI.
LIGHTING: moderately dark night, readable cool slate and desaturated teal ground, water still visibly textured, cliffs retain their form, thin subdued blue-grey fog only around the outer approaches. Strong expressive amber lantern and golden beam, local warm bounce on rocks and nearby pier; bright enemies remain clearly readable outside beam. Do not crush shadows, blanket scene in black or use neon bloom.
COMPOSITION: much more free battlefield than preparation. World fills canvas behind slim top and bottom slate HUD bands. Lighthouse centered around x52%,y53%; visible gameplay occupies about 80% of height. Keep ample approach space around it. No constant sidebars or device lists.
BATTLE: show one coherent mid-fight moment, 5 enemies total, all with clean small black-backed health bars. Two small pale cyan hooded ghosts stand side-by-side on the land upper-left of lighthouse, at different angles so neither occludes the other. A single narrow warm transparent fan of light (roughly 24 degrees total) goes FROM lighthouse position toward these two ghosts upper-left, with clear finite range ending before the edge; it illuminates exactly those TWO targets, with warm outlines and tiny restrained hit sparks. Light must have one apex and no branching or extra beams. Keep ground texture visible through it. A faint broken golden range ellipse on the ground agrees with the beam end. A thin pale aim marker at the beam end, no thick targeting lines. Outside that beam: one squat corrupted stone-armored turtle with visibly cracked shell and separate short steel-blue armor bar above its red health bar at lower-left; one horned dark minotaur farther upper-left with a restrained small red windup chevron, and one small bat over water to the right, approaching the defenders. Distinct silhouettes, readable sprites, no crowd. Cannons and barrier have small greenish condition bars. No shield dome, boss, ship, invented abilities or resource drops.
HUD: preserve graphitic slate stone, chipped grey pixel bevels and warm cream pixel Cyrillic of preparation, but panels slender. One continuous top band, around 9% height: left a small lighthouse icon, exact label "МАЯК" and value "96 / 120" above a clear muted green health bar; center "НОЧЬ 3 · КРЫЛАТЫЙ ПРИЛИВ" with smaller "ВОЛНЫ 2/4 · ОТБИТО 1"; right "01:08" and compact stone pause button "II". No Back, resources, currency pluses, upgrades, recon, placement controls or start-night button.
BOTTOM band about 11% height: left small lens emblem and "БАЗОВАЯ ЛИНЗА" with "В СВЕТЕ 2/2"; center a broad touch-friendly slate button with a pixel sunburst icon, "ВСПЫШКА", second line "ГОТОВА", a restrained amber edge; right a broad slate action button with "ВЫЗВАТЬ ВОЛНУ", second line "ДО СЛЕДУЮЩЕЙ 00:18", and readable small footnote "БОНУС ПОСЛЕ ЗАВЕРШЕНИЯ". This is a callable early wave, not claiming the reward already earned. All text verbatim, crisp correctly spelled uppercase Cyrillic, no other copy. Grey/cream regular text, amber reserved for light and ready ability, red reserved for damage/threat. Calm dark interiors to panels, no extravagant gold ornament.
The result should look like the same game as preparation, already in playable battle, with clear target-switching choices. This is a design reference, not marketing art.

mobile.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished portrait PHONE battle-screen reference for «Маяк», matching the newly generated desktop battle reference exactly in visual identity and battle state, adapted thoughtfully for touch. Single 9:19.5 portrait image ideally 780×1688, full screen edge to edge. No physical phone, no external frame, no side-by-side board.
Input images: Image 1 is PRIMARY style and content reference, the finished DESKTOP BATTLE. Image 2 is the existing PHONE PREPARATION screenshot, useful ONLY for portrait aspect, the original pixel lettering, slate material and coastal world identity; none of its preparation commands belong in battle.
MATCH image 1: moderate night brightness, cool desaturated teal ground, visibly textured blue sea, golden warm beam and lantern, same narrow stone lighthouse with red-brown cap, same small pier below lighthouse, two bronze cannons to its left and short stone barrier inland, same monsters and game state. Land stays LEFT, sea RIGHT, irregular layered cliff coastline runs vertically through the field. This must look like a responsive view of the same coastal battlefield, never a new island or dramatically different zoomed illustration. Tilted top-down view, no sky/horizon. Keep crisp stepped pixels and distinct limited color clusters throughout, including every Cyrillic glyph; no smooth fantasy illustration typography.
PHONE COMPOSITION: slim top slate HUD about 13% screen height, huge uninterrupted battlefield about 73%, compact bottom dock about 14%. Fit the lighthouse, both cannons, barrier, all 5 enemies and full useful beam range inside the field without touching HUD. Keep lighthouse near x53%,y51% of field. Sprite scale must make the monsters easy to identify on a 390px-wide phone while allowing space between objects. Extra world space can extend above/below, maintain object proportions; don't squish or stretch the desktop screenshot.
BATTLE SAME SNAPSHOT: exactly two pale cyan hooded ghosts side-by-side at upper-left of lighthouse within ONE narrow transparent amber light fan, emitting tiny sparks and warm outlines. Fan has a single apex FROM lighthouse lantern toward upper-left, finite curved end and roughly 24 degrees total angle, ground visible through it. Exactly those TWO ghosts are lit, no second beam. Golden faint broken range ellipse, no other confusing circles. Outside beam: one dark horned minotaur farther upper-left with small red windup chevron; one squat corrupted armored turtle lower-left, cracked dark shell and distinct blue armor bar above red health bar; one small bat over water to right. Each monster has thin readable health bars with black backing; defenders have muted green condition bars. Cool subdued fog only along outer approaches, not covering health bars. Preserve all these relative locations. No new objects, rewards, shields, boss or ship.
TOP HUD exact text, chunky cream pixel Cyrillic: first row small lighthouse icon and "МАЯК 96 / 120" with green health bar beneath, compact pause stone button "II" at top-right with finger-size touch area. Second row "НОЧЬ 3 · КРЫЛАТЫЙ ПРИЛИВ" (can wrap cleanly to 2 short lines if needed), below it "ВОЛНЫ 2/4 · ОТБИТО 1", small elapsed clock "01:08" aligned right. All readable at phone size, no cramped overflowing line.
BOTTOM: a narrow status strip with a small blue lens icon, "БАЗОВАЯ ЛИНЗА" and "В СВЕТЕ 2/2", visually quieter than actions. Below the strip, TWO equal-height finger-friendly large slate buttons side-by-side with a generous separation: left amber pixel sunburst icon and "ВСПЫШКА", second line "ГОТОВА"; right "ВЫЗВАТЬ ВОЛНУ" wrapping into 2 lines if needed and "ЧЕРЕЗ 00:18". A single small but readable line beneath right button or across dock "БОНУС ПОСЛЕ ЗАВЕРШЕНИЯ". Gold edge on ready flash, restrained neutral bevel on wave. Buttons and safe margin fit fully above bottom edge. Match desktop stone, ink and amber exactly.
Remove all preparation UI: no Back, pluses, bank currencies, upgrades, recon, placement controls, start button or object/type counters. No permanent sidebar, device list or explanatory legends. Exact correctly spelled Cyrillic only as requested, no extra copy. This is a usable game HUD design reference with moderate night atmosphere and expressive readable light, not poster art.
